response.description: Now you can use the open-source DocumentDB Kubernetes Operator to run DocumentDB on Kubernetes. DocumentDB is a Mongo-DB–compatible, open-source document database built on PostgreSQL. The operator extends Kubernetes with custom resource definitions (CRDs) and makes it easier for you to deploy and manage DocumentDB clusters using familiar tools such as kubectl and Helm. Learn more.
response.title: Open Source: Announcing the DocumentDB Kubernetes Operator
